assumptions: The registrar lists a USD 63,500 program fee for the cohort entering Fall 2026 across five quarters, including Fall 2027.
This is the tuition-like instructional program fee only. Separately itemized service, campus, insurance and other fees are excluded; some later-quarter fees are TBD.
The Fall 2026 cohort schedule is used as a published-rate planning reference, not the fee schedule for a new Fall 2027 cohort or a guaranteed final bill.
The annual USD 50,800 program fee covers four quarters, not the full five-quarter degree. No unconfirmed aid is deducted.

directory_policies.notes.9: Cost context: Instructional program fee USD 63,500 for the Fall 2026 entering cohort; annual USD 50,800 is incomplete. New Fall 2027 cohort pricing and ancillary fee totals remain unverified.

fact_summary: Page 1 identifies the Fall 2026 cohort and five-quarter instructional program fee separately from ancillary fees; annual charges are not the degree total.
